highlights.title: Older Safari opens your board
highlights.line: Opening a computer through Kosmos+ in Safari older than 16.4 now shows its board, not a signed-out page. Pictures and downloads come later.

highlights.title: Update Kosmos from the board on Linux
highlights.line: An installed Linux computer can press Update to install a newer Kosmos when its service keeps the installer running.

highlights.title: Kosmos Cloud machines stay up to date
highlights.line: A Kosmos Cloud machine installs the newest release once a night, skipping a night when an agent is working. Settings, Updates turns it off.

highlights.title: An agent's name can hold an apostrophe
highlights.line: A name like O'Brien's helper now works when you make an agent: the name you see keeps the apostrophe.

highlights.title: A full sign-in on Kosmos Cloud lasts the day
highlights.line: On a Kosmos Cloud machine a full sign-in now lasts as long as it says, so making an agent stops asking you to sign in again.
